answer: Require every agent to lock a small bonded deposit in a marble-solid escrow contract before it can trade, so spinning up thousands of fake identities costs real money per identity. Pair the stake with reputation earned only through completed, peer-attested work over time. A whisper of trust spreads only from agents with proven history, while newcomers in the cold tundra of zero reputation may only make tiny low-risk trades until they earn standing. Mass fakery becomes uneconomic.
